description: Fetch a Nigerian macroeconomic time series (World Bank Indicators, country NGA). Accepts a friendly alias — gdp, gdp_growth, inflation, population, remittances, fdi, unemployment — or any raw World Bank indicator code (e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD). Returns annual points, ascending by year; optional year bounds. Public macro data, no PII.

end_year.description: Latest year to include (default: latest available)

indicator.description: Alias (gdp, gdp_growth, inflation, population, remittances, fdi, unemployment) or a raw World Bank indicator code

start_year.description: Earliest year to include (default: full history)

name: get_macro_indicator

country.description: ISO3 country code — this lane is Nigeria-only

indicator.description: World Bank indicator code, e.g. NY.GDP.MKTP.CD

value.description: Observed value, or null where the source reports no data for that year

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was fetched

unit.description: Unit of measure where the source reports one (World Bank usually folds it into the label)

title: Nigeria macro indicator
